title: Upstreams
body: A Winnipeg marketplace connecting business byproducts with people who can put them to use.
detail: Upstreams turns a local problem into a practical platform: helping useful materials find their next purpose. It brings my interest in systems and community building together.

sections.label: THE IDEA
sections.copy: One business’s byproduct can be another person’s starting point. Make those possibilities easier to discover and connect.

sections.label: THE PROJECT
sections.copy: A live marketplace prototype exploring how local businesses and communities can exchange useful materials.

sections.label: WHAT IT SHOWS
sections.copy: Turning a broad community ambition into a focused product people can explore. The prototype is a starting point, with room to learn from real use.
